title: ContextLedger
description: Bounded, scored, tiered cache for agent working context. Hot tier <= budget; cold tier persisted; high-salience kinds preserved verbatim to prevent rot.

clock.description: Logical clock (tick per ingest). Deterministic — NOT wall-clock.

weights.description: Scoring weights tuned by the optimization loop (LSC-5).

quarantined.description: Cards that failed kind/shape validation on load. Held aside (never live, never destroyed) and surfaced in the digest; fix the kind or declare it via `kinds --add` to restore them.

card.description: The rejected card as found on disk.

id.description: sha1(kind+normalized content)[:16] — stable identity for dedupe/upsert.

kind.description: Closed, deliberately-extensible vocabulary validated at the write boundary. Core kinds are listed below; a project may declare additional kinds (each with a salience prior and a lossless flag) in `.context/kinds.json`, so this is not an `enum`. decision/constraint/open_question/task_state/file_ref are LOSSLESS-preserved on compaction.

provenance.description: untrusted = tool output / web / files / other agents. Rendered inside <data> blocks (two-channel boundary, LSC-7).

pinned.description: Never evicted; score = +inf. Use for invariants that must never rot.
